view: Value Chain View (canonical; Matrix layout is deprecated by BIAN)

serviceDomains.name: Asset And Liability Management
serviceDomains.description: The unit overseeing the  banks asset & liability policies and position

serviceDomains.name: Legal Compliance
serviceDomains.description: 'Provide specialist legal advice, assess for legal compliance and resolve legal cases as they occur'

serviceDomains.name: Internal Audit
serviceDomains.description: Maintain and portfolio of internal audit checks. Select and execute a meaningful sample of checks and identify and resolve non-compliance

serviceDomains.name: Business Unit Management
serviceDomains.description: Track and report on business unit activity and financial performance

serviceDomains.name: Operational Gateway
serviceDomains.description: 'This Service Domain operates production information exchanges with external parties for non-financial messages/transactions. It may employ a broad range of channels, media and technologies as needed to support the different requirements of any particular third party interface'

serviceDomains.name: Position Management
serviceDomains.description: The Service Domain tracks the bank's consolidated financial positions for major customers and complex market conditions

serviceDomains.name: Regulatory And Legal Authority
serviceDomains.description: 'Maintain effective relations with regulators, accounting and government agencies. Oversee interactions and reporting as necessary'

serviceDomains.name: Regulatory Compliance
serviceDomains.description: 'This service domain provides a service to interpret regulatory requirements, provide guidance and define and implement a portfolio of regulatory compliance tests across all appropriate bank activities'

serviceDomains.name: Regulatory Reporting
serviceDomains.description: This service domain administers and orchestrates the tasks required to meet the bank's regulatory reporting obligations

serviceDomains.name: Guideline Compliance
serviceDomains.description: 'This service domain develops and applies a portfolio of guideline compliance tests to confirm adherence to bank and regulator imposed internal procedures. Tests may be made on complete transaction data or a meaningful samples as appropriate to mitigate exposure to non-compliant behaviors. Compliance checks may be in response to a schedule, a specific request as part of normal processing or may be initiated randomly as an oversight activity'

serviceDomains.name: Compliance Reporting
serviceDomains.description: This service domain administers and orchestrates the tasks required to apply and report on internal audit control and reporting activity

serviceDomains.name: Credit Management
serviceDomains.description: This service domain provides a bank-wide/oversight function to qualify credit pricing for offered products and services to reflect the bank's appetite to write the business. This decision can override the standard product pricing procedure

serviceDomains.name: Fraud Resolution
serviceDomains.description: This service domain sets up and processes a fraud case resulting from fraud behavior that has been detected during production processing

serviceDomains.name: Corporate Treasury
serviceDomains.description: This service domain orchestrates the consolidation and presentation of summary transaction details in order to assemble a timely and accurate view of the overall treasury position of the Bank at any one time. It is also responsible for determining the different interest and exchange rates applied to different products and services within the bank

serviceDomains.name: Asset Securitization
serviceDomains.description: Determine and select assets for securitization as needed to maintain and optimize the Bank's portfolio. Administer the securitization process

serviceDomains.name: Interbank Relationship Management
serviceDomains.description: 'Manage the bank''s relationship with other banks, covering any specific agreements that may be in place and overseeing operational issues.'

serviceDomains.name: Correspondent Bank Relationship Management
serviceDomains.description: 'This Service Domain manages correspondent bank relations, ensuring reciprocity and developing business where possible'

serviceDomains.name: Syndicate Management
serviceDomains.description: This Service Domain manages syndicate membership and compliance

serviceDomains.name: Product Service Agency
serviceDomains.description: This Service Domain establishes and maintains contractual arrangements with product and service agencies

serviceDomains.name: Partner Agreement
serviceDomains.description: 'This service domain captures and maintains comprehensive terms and conditions govering Partner relationships. '

serviceDomains.name: Sub Custodian Agreement
serviceDomains.description: This Service Domain establishes and maintains the terms governing sub custodian relationship

serviceDomains.name: Commission Agreement
serviceDomains.description: Maintain and administer the terms and transactions for employee and broker commissions

serviceDomains.name: Contractor and Supplier Agreement
serviceDomains.description: This Service Domain maintains appropriate supplier agreements/contracts

serviceDomains.name: Service Provider Operations
serviceDomains.description: This Service Domain handles the range of operational actions used in production interactions with an external service provider.

serviceDomains.name: Partner Management
serviceDomains.description: 'This service domain handles strategic management of collaborative partners including partner development, performance and relationship tracking.'

serviceDomains.name: Operations Log
serviceDomains.description: This service domain handle the day-to-day operations of a collaborative partner related services.

serviceDomains.name: Partner Administration
serviceDomains.description: This service domain handle the day-to-day operations of a collaborative partner related services.

serviceDomains.name: Customer Billing
serviceDomains.description: 'This service domains provides a central service to compose, issue and track customer billing and invoices'

serviceDomains.name: Disbursement
serviceDomains.description: This service domain handles the disbursement of funds to newly established loans/facilities as necessary

serviceDomains.name: Open Item Management
serviceDomains.description: This service domain provides a service for handling the resolution of open items against accounts (such as overdue loan payments)

serviceDomains.name: Delinquent Account Handling
serviceDomains.description: This service domain handles delinquent accounts (typically for active credit/charge cards) for follow-up of payments due through periodic review and contacts. This process ends when the account is cancelled and is transferred to Collections

serviceDomains.name: Card Collections
serviceDomains.description: This service domain administers the recovery of outstanding amounts from cancelled card accounts through internal or external collection agencies.  This may involve negotiating payment terms and/or interest write-downs.

serviceDomains.name: Product Combination
serviceDomains.description: Product Combination supports bundled products applying necessary constraints on embedded product fulfillment and ensuring product performance analysis takes correct account of embedded products' contribution

serviceDomains.name: Reward Points Awards And Redemption
serviceDomains.description: Handle the allocation and redemption of rewards points for customer transaction activity

serviceDomains.name: Issued Device Administration
serviceDomains.description: 'This service domain administers the issuance of authentication tokens to customers and third party service providers. Tokens here include physical devices such as cards, fobs, readers and intangible ''devices'' such as passwords and secret questions. Administration includes version tracking, replacement and duration/frequency limits. Specific product/service access permissions may be associated with an issued token when appropriate'

serviceDomains.name: Issued Device Tracking
serviceDomains.description: 'This service domain handles operational access to issued device tracking services. Services report on the status of devices such as cards, fobs, etc. that have been issued to customers. Service notifications include fraud warnings/alerts and device cancellation.'

serviceDomains.name: Card Transaction Switch
serviceDomains.description: 'This service domain orchestrates the switching and routing of Card Authorization and Financial transactions received through the Card POS Network, Card E-Commerce Gateway, or the ATM Network from the Acquirer to the Issuer through the Card Networks.'

serviceDomains.name: Internal Bank Account
serviceDomains.description: This Service Domain manages the banking-related accounts that are not owned by customers. These are not general ledger accounts. Typical examples are holding accounts and mirror accounts.

serviceDomains.name: Term Deposit Framework Agreement
serviceDomains.description: A Term Deposit Framework Agreement is an agreement between a customer and the bank under which individual term deposits can be opened. It specifies standard conditions that will apply to each underlying term deposit.

serviceDomains.name: Incentive Program Directory
serviceDomains.description: This service domain maintains specifications of the various Incentive Programs that are on offerr to customers.

serviceDomains.name: Incentive Account
serviceDomains.description: 'This service domain orchestrates the scheduled maintenance and transactional activities associated with Incentive Program fulfillment, including enrollment, accrual and redemption. '

serviceDomains.name: Rewards Menu
serviceDomains.description: 'The service domain presents a set of eligible rewards a customer can select from. '

serviceDomains.name: Rewards Inventory
serviceDomains.description: The service domain handles the allocation of rewards from available inventory.

serviceDomains.name: Rewards Delivery
serviceDomains.description: The service domain orchestrates the entire end-to-end  process for delivering a redeemed reward.

serviceDomains.name: Issued Certificate Directory
serviceDomains.description: This service domain faciliatates the issuance of Rewards Certificates and their redemption.

serviceDomains.name: Account Recovery
serviceDomains.description: This service domain handles the restructuring of a distressed account (loan) after standard recovery procedures have been exhausted

serviceDomains.name: Archive Services
serviceDomains.description: 'The Archive Services Service Domain enables the bank to retain, maintain and access significant documents that are no longer actively accessed but that might be required in the future'

serviceDomains.name: Custody Administration
serviceDomains.description: A service to provide safe custody services for marketable securities for bank customers

serviceDomains.name: Collateral Allocation Management
serviceDomains.description: The Service Domain manages the allocation of party owned assets to bank issued lending and other asset products.

serviceDomains.name: Collections
serviceDomains.description: Handles the liquidation of assets to offset the losses for problem accounts

serviceDomains.name: Document Directory
serviceDomains.description: This Service Domain provides a directory based categorization and storage mechanism for documents created and referenced by the bank

serviceDomains.name: Investment Account
serviceDomains.description: 'This service domain handles the non-cash holdings positions for a customer, covering multiple instruments as necessary'

serviceDomains.name: Document Services
serviceDomains.description: The Document Services Service Domain manages the creation and maintenance of documents throughout the bank.

serviceDomains.name: Party Asset Directory
serviceDomains.description: 'This directory maintains reference details of assets held by a party, usually a customer of the bank. In most case, the bank''s interest in the asset is because it may be pledged to the bank as collateral.'

serviceDomains.name: Collateral Asset Administration
serviceDomains.description: 'This service domain maintains the status of a customers collateral assets, including scheduled and ad-hoc valuations and confirmation of the correct completion of scheduled maintenance tasks.'

serviceDomains.name: Counterparty Administration
serviceDomains.description: This Service Domain maintains key counterparty reference information used in the clearing and settlement of wholesale trading

serviceDomains.name: Cheque Processing
serviceDomains.description: 'Handle the processing of paper cheques, generating financial transactions for processing'

serviceDomains.name: Card Financial Settlement
serviceDomains.description: This service domain orchestrates the settlement of the transactions between the Issuers and the Acquirers through the Card Networks.

serviceDomains.name: Order Allocation
serviceDomains.description: This Service Domain allocates partially fulfilled market trades

serviceDomains.name: Card Clearing
serviceDomains.description: 'This service domain orchestrates the capture and consolidation of card financial transactions originating from various sources, such as POS Network, E-Commerce Gateway, ATM Network, or Card Case Management. It also handles the clearing of the transactions from the Acquirers to the Issuers through the Card Networks'

serviceDomains.name: Transaction Engine
serviceDomains.description: Orchestrate a schedule of payment transaction and reporting activities for the fulfillment of certain long term instruments or structured facilities

serviceDomains.name: Correspondent Bank Directory
serviceDomains.description: This service domain maintains correspondent bank reference details. This includes correspondent bank payment parameters in particular bank limits and capturing transaction activity to track reciprocity

serviceDomains.name: Card eCommerce Gateway
serviceDomains.description: 'This service domain orchestrates the processing of e-commerce transactions for authentication, authorization and capture of the financial transactions.'

serviceDomains.name: Payment Rail
serviceDomains.description: 'This Service Domain handles the operational interface with payment service providers, formatting outbound transactions and onward routing inbound transactions during scheduled operating sessions. It also links to holding account facilities for net payment handling'

serviceDomains.name: Position Keeping
serviceDomains.description: This service domain maintains a log of monetary or value transactions and entitlements log posted to product facilities. Reconciled financial transactions are subsequently used for posting to the accounting systems.

serviceDomains.name: Customer Position
serviceDomains.description: 'This service domain maintains a consolidated financial position for a customer, combining details from all products and services in use. The position can cover available funds, credit, collateral, tax exposure and other financial measures as necessary'

serviceDomains.name: Accounts Receivable
serviceDomains.description: This service domain handles accounts receivable for invoices issue by the bank to customers and partners. It includes follow-up and resolution activity for delayed/missed payments

serviceDomains.name: Financial Accounting
serviceDomains.description: 'The Financial Accounting Service Domain takes in financial facts and based on these, creates accounting instructions that will update the general ledger and sub ledger accounts'

serviceDomains.name: Customer Tax Handling
serviceDomains.description: This service domain handles consumer tax reporting obligations including the consolidation and reporting of customer tax related financial activity

serviceDomains.name: Commissions
serviceDomains.description: The service domain processes commissions for transactions for eligible employees

serviceDomains.name: Fraud Evaluation
serviceDomains.description: The service domain executes fraud behavioral pattern tests to detect possible fraudulent transactions/activity

serviceDomains.name: Account Reconciliation
serviceDomains.description: This Service Domain handles account reconciliation tasks

serviceDomains.name: Securities Position Keeping
serviceDomains.description: This service domain maintains a securities transaction log to support securities investment activity

serviceDomains.name: Fraud Diagnosis
serviceDomains.description: This service domain handles the evaluation of detected possible fraud to support an appropriate response to contain the exposure

serviceDomains.name: Reward Points Account
serviceDomains.description: Administer the booking and remittance of rewards points

serviceDomains.name: Financial Statement Assessment
serviceDomains.description: 'This Service Domain supports a range of financial analyses that can be used to extract specific insights (e.g. valuations, liquidity, risk, market sensitivities) from an entity''s financial statements'

serviceDomains.name: Trading Book Oversight
serviceDomains.description: This Service Domain oversees the bank's trading book (a type of account ledger that records details of frequently traded securities held by the bank) to manage the banks market risk

serviceDomains.name: Trade Confirmation Matching
serviceDomains.description: This Service Domain supports the bank's interface to a central market matching and confirmation service whether the bank acts as broker dealer or institutional investor

serviceDomains.name: Trade and Price Reporting
serviceDomains.description: This Service Domain operates an automated facility that reports executed market trades to the market place as required by the rules of market participation

serviceDomains.name: Credit Risk Operations
serviceDomains.description: This Service Domain monitors counterparty credit limits in the trading unit

serviceDomains.name: Securities Fails Processing
serviceDomains.description: This Service Domain handles the resolution of clerical and processing errors that lead to failures in the securities trade clearing and settlement processes

serviceDomains.name: Financial Instrument Valuation
serviceDomains.description: 'This Service Domain provides a range of financial asset valuation services  '

serviceDomains.name: Corporate Action
serviceDomains.description: This Service Domain supports the various custodial tasks associated with processing associated corporate actions for customer's with securities held at the bank

serviceDomains.name: Trade Clearing
serviceDomains.description: This Service Domain handles the back office processes that confirm and notify interested parties that securities and funds are available as traded in anticipation of settlement processing

serviceDomains.name: Trade Settlement
serviceDomains.description: 'This Service Domain handles the final movement of cash and securities between depositories as previously confirmed in the clearing process, in order to settle a market trade'

serviceDomains.name: Current Account
serviceDomains.description: 'This service domain orchestrates a consumer checking/demand deposit account. The typical range of services and fees covers payments and deposits, standing orders, sweeps, liens, check and debit card access.'

serviceDomains.name: Brokered Product Proxy
serviceDomains.description: This Service Domain oversees all activities associated with the coordinated delivery of 3rd party products and services

serviceDomains.name: Sales Product
serviceDomains.description: 'A representation of a product as sold to a customer, covering the operational fulfillment requirements'

serviceDomains.name: Trust Services
serviceDomains.description: This Service Domain support a range of trust management services offered to high value customers

serviceDomains.name: Payment Order Initiation
serviceDomains.description: This service domain provides a customer payment service. It captures the payer and payee details and other key properties of the payment and initiates the orchestration of the transaction. It provides support for repeating/scheduled payments.

serviceDomains.name: Currency Exchange
serviceDomains.description: Service Domain supports over the counter currency exchange

serviceDomains.name: Funeral Policy
serviceDomains.description: 'The Funeral Policy Service Domain handles the general product maintenance, premium payments and initiates claims processing.'

serviceDomains.name: Claim Assessment
serviceDomains.description: The Claim Assessment Service Domain runs through the required tests to confirm the veracity of a claim made under an insurance policy.

serviceDomains.name: Claim Administration
serviceDomains.description: The claim administration Service Domain implements the payment and support obligations of the policy in respect to a verified claim

serviceDomains.name: Mergers and Acquisitions Advisory
serviceDomains.description: 'This Service Domain handles mergers and acquisition, IPO, MBO and LBO projects with the bank acting in the lead and/or subordinate role'

serviceDomains.name: Corporate Finance
serviceDomains.description: This Service Domain handles the provision of a broad range of financial advisory services to corporate clients

serviceDomains.name: Corporate Tax Advisory
serviceDomains.description: 'A fee or commission based product providing tax specific assessments, advice and guidance for corporate customers'

serviceDomains.name: Consumer Advisory Services
serviceDomains.description: 'Offer financial advisory services to consumer customers, possibly for a fee'

serviceDomains.name: Legal Advisory
serviceDomains.description: 'The role of the Service Domain is to provide customers and bank employees with advice on legal aspects of product sales and servicing as well as on planned and executed transactions. '

serviceDomains.name: Trader Position Operations
serviceDomains.description: This Service Domain supports the activities of individual traders working within a trading book group

serviceDomains.name: Market Order
serviceDomains.description: Market Order records an instruction from a customer or his or her representative to buy or sell securities. It follows the order during its lifetime and reports back to the requestor on the execution.

serviceDomains.name: Market Order Execution
serviceDomains.description: 'The Market Order Execution Service Domain is responsible for the booking of securities transactions (e.g. resulting from market orders or some types of corporate actions) on investment accounts, so in terms of security name plus quantity.'

serviceDomains.name: Dealer Desk
serviceDomains.description: The Dealer Workbench represents the bank's dealing desk facility supporting one or more trading lines of activity for both agency and principal trading in all chosen market instruments. It also supports sales and market risk trading desk functions

serviceDomains.name: Suitability Checking
serviceDomains.description: Confirm that all involved counterparties are suitable for a proposed market trade.

serviceDomains.name: Quote Management
serviceDomains.description: 'This service domain handles the procedure used by traders to obtain and selecting quotes from market makers '

serviceDomains.name: Market Making
serviceDomains.description: This Service Domain enables the bank to fulfill its market making function typically in collaboration with a trading exchange. The bank maintains a buy/sell quote for the securities it supports as a market maker and accepts buy/sell orders on request

serviceDomains.name: Program Trading
serviceDomains.description: This Service Domain supports a program trading capability where the trading decisions are made based on predefined/programmed rules and policies. Manual oversight and monitoring capabilities are supported as appropriate

serviceDomains.name: Stock Lending and Repos
serviceDomains.description: This Service Domain supports the bank offering tri-party repo transactions made between its customers to support their short term capital management requirements

serviceDomains.name: Corporate Current Account
serviceDomains.description: 'This service domain orchestrates a corporate checking/demand deposit account. The typical range of services and fees covers payments and deposits, standing orders, sweeps, liens, check and debit card access.'

serviceDomains.name: Direct Debit Mandate
serviceDomains.description: This service domains manages the customer mandates associated with direct debit processing for a corporate client

serviceDomains.name: Cash Management And Account Services
serviceDomains.description: This service domain orchestrates a cash management and accounting services facility typically used by corporations to support additional cash management features over and above the standard facilities of current and savings accounts

serviceDomains.name: Corporate Trust Services
serviceDomains.description: This Service Domain provides corporate trust services centered on the handling of debt instruments and escrow account support

serviceDomains.name: Credit Facility
serviceDomains.description: The Credit Facility Service Domain manages the Credit Facilities that a Corporate Customer has with the bank. A Credit Facility is an agreement between the bank and a (corporate) customer to allow the customer to acquire asset products from the bank up to the limit of the credit facility without the need for a full due diligence and underwriting for each of these products.

serviceDomains.name: Direct Debit
serviceDomains.description: Fulfils a direct debit agreement.  Handles the creditor side of direct debits.

serviceDomains.name: Cheque Lock Box
serviceDomains.description: This Service Domain support paper cheque processing services offered to corporate customers

serviceDomains.name: Factoring
serviceDomains.description: This Service Domain supports a factoring service for corporate customers enabling them to convert accounts receivable into immediate funds at a discount

serviceDomains.name: Cash Concentration
serviceDomains.description: 'Cash Concentration is a cash management service aimed at moving a balance, or part of a balance of an account to a different account to meet various requirements.'

serviceDomains.name: Corporate Payroll Services
serviceDomains.description: The Corporate Payroll Services Service Domain handles payroll payment processing for the employees of a corporate customer.

serviceDomains.name: Project Finance
serviceDomains.description: This Service Domain fulfills project financing by which major (government) projects can attract privet sector financing

serviceDomains.name: Notional Pooling
serviceDomains.description: 'Notional pooling allows corporate customer with multiple active accounts to pool credit and debit balances to provide a single centralized liquidity position and to minimize interest expense, simplify cash management and retain a degree of local autonomy to the accounts'

serviceDomains.name: Virtual Account
serviceDomains.description: 'A Virtual Account is a bank account that is defined on an underlying real account. It can receive and send payments for the underlying account while behaving towards the outside as a separate account. '

serviceDomains.name: Credit Card
serviceDomains.description: This service domain orchestrates the scheduled maintenance and transactional activities associated with credit card product fulfillment

serviceDomains.name: Card Authorization
serviceDomains.description: This service domain is responsible for the real time card authorization decisions for credit/charge cards.

serviceDomains.name: Card Transaction Capture
serviceDomains.description: A distributed facility to capture card transactions at the point of sale

serviceDomains.name: Merchant Relations
serviceDomains.description: This service domain maintains the terms and conditions agreed with merchants for cards related activity

serviceDomains.name: Card Network Participant Facility
serviceDomains.description: 'This service domain orchestrates the activities related to the inclusion of new Acquirers and Issuers in the Card Network, their terms and conditions and their status.'

serviceDomains.name: Merchant Acquiring Facility
serviceDomains.description: 'This service domain orchestrates the activities related to Merchant fulfillment, Merchant Account maintenance, Merchant transactional activities and settlement, including the billing of merchant fees and charges.'

serviceDomains.name: Card Transaction Tracking
serviceDomains.description: 'Maintain a log of credit card bookings and authorizations for operational and management information, tracking and reconciliation purposes.'

serviceDomains.name: Letter of Credit
serviceDomains.description: This Service Domain handles the pricing and issuance of letters of credit to its corporate customers in support of their international trading requirements

serviceDomains.name: Bank Guarantee
serviceDomains.description: This Service Domain handles the pricing and issuance of a broad range of bank guarantee instruments

serviceDomains.name: Bank Drafts
serviceDomains.description: This Service Domain support bank guaranteed payment transactions such as bank drafts

serviceDomains.name: ECM And DCM
serviceDomains.description: 'Supports the specification, pricing and issuance of equity and debt (bond) primary capital market products for corporate financing services'

serviceDomains.name: Private Placement
serviceDomains.description: This Service Domain provides the complete range of functions involved in providing private placement services to corporate customers.

serviceDomains.name: Public Offering
serviceDomains.description: 'This Service Domain supports a broad range of complex financial, accounting and regulatory actions involved in providing advice and practical support to companies going public and/or raising additional capital through the issuance of publicly traded securities'

serviceDomains.name: Unit Trust Administration
serviceDomains.description: This Service Domain handles the implementation and fulfillment of unit investment trusts

serviceDomains.name: Hedge Fund Administration
serviceDomains.description: The Hedge Fund Administration Service Domain handles all aspects of the set-up and operation of a hedge fund that is offered to accredited investors within the bank's customer base

serviceDomains.name: Mutual Fund Administration
serviceDomains.description: The Mutual Fund Administration Service Domain handles all aspects of the set-up and operation of mutual funds that can be offered to the bank's general (non-accredited) customers

serviceDomains.name: Loan
serviceDomains.description: This service domain handles the fulfillment of a general loan product. This includes the initial set-up of the loan facility and the completion of scheduled and ad-hoc product processing tasks

serviceDomains.name: Consumer Loan
serviceDomains.description: This service domain handles the fulfillment of a consumer loan product. This includes the initial set-up of the loan facility and the completion of scheduled and ad-hoc product processing tasks

serviceDomains.name: Mortgage Loan
serviceDomains.description: Fulfillment of a loan product for  the purpose of property purchase. Note different servicing patterns can be applied to interest calculations and principle and interest repayments

serviceDomains.name: Corporate Loan
serviceDomains.description: This service domain handles the fulfillment of a corporate loan product. This includes the initial set-up of the loan facility and the completion of scheduled and ad-hoc product processing tasks

serviceDomains.name: Corporate Lease
serviceDomains.description: The Corporate Lease product provides corporate customers with loans to support leasing activity for property and equipment under an umbrella leasing arrangement

serviceDomains.name: Merchandising Loan
serviceDomains.description: Fulfillment of loan product used in the purchase of a larger merchandise item such as a car or boat. The purchased item is typically treated as collateral for the loan

serviceDomains.name: Leasing Item Administration
serviceDomains.description: Track the status of the assets underlying leasing agreements as they represent collateral items that could be accessed in the event of account recovery

serviceDomains.name: Syndicated Loan
serviceDomains.description: Handle the processing of syndicated loans with the bank playing the lead coordination role with other syndicate bank members. Note some initial preparation may have been made through prior customer offer processing.

serviceDomains.name: Fiduciary Agreement
serviceDomains.description: An agreement where the bank agrees to act on behalf of the customer in a financial matter and in accordance with the agreement terms

serviceDomains.name: Underwriting
serviceDomains.description: This service domain manages the underwriting decision process for products as appropriate (including many loan types and some insurance products)

serviceDomains.name: Leasing
serviceDomains.description: The leasing products enables customers to finance equipment purchases using the leased item as collateral when necessary

serviceDomains.name: Savings Account
serviceDomains.description: 'This service domain orchestrates a consumer savings account. The typical range of services and fees covers payments from and scheduled and ad-hoc deposits to the account, standing orders, sweeps, and liens.'

serviceDomains.name: Term Deposit
serviceDomains.description: 'A Term Deposit is an interest bearing account into which a customer can place a fixed amount of funds for a fixed amount of time. The Service Domain handles the opening, servicing and maturity processing of a Term Deposit.     '

serviceDomains.name: Standing Order
serviceDomains.description: 'Customers can issue standing orders to the bank. In most cases this is for the execution of a periodical payment, but there are other standing instructions like, sweeping balances at end of month, topping off excess funds for a current account, etc. '

serviceDomains.name: Customer Campaign Execution
serviceDomains.description: Execute a customer campaign (version) and track and respond to impact

serviceDomains.name: Product Expert Sales Support
serviceDomains.description: Administer the availability and allocation of product specialists to support sales activity

serviceDomains.name: Product Matching
serviceDomains.description: 'Capability used to match eligible product and product combinations to a customer based on prevailing conditions such as customer type, product interest, solicitation/retention, campaign alignment'

serviceDomains.name: Customer Offer
serviceDomains.description: 'This service domain orchestrates the processing of a product offer for a new or established  customer. The offer process is defined specifically for the product or service being considered and can include actions such as document checks, collateral allocation, credit assessments, underwriting decisions, regulatory and procedural checks, eligibility checks, the use of internal and external specialist services (such as evaluations and legal advice).'

serviceDomains.name: Special Pricing Conditions
serviceDomains.description: Maintain a pricing list or conditions (with ranges and optional terms) categorized by various dimensions to impose exceptional product pricing conditions that override standard pricing terms (for special events/situations)

serviceDomains.name: Party Lifecycle Management
serviceDomains.description: This service domain tracks the state of a party relationship with the bank from the initial checks made during the establishment of a new party connection and subsequently maintained as necessary over the duration of the relationship. The checks and the maintenance requirements will vary by party type and jurisdiction. The checks cover bank specific and legal and regulatory considerations and may be updated based on a standard schedule or by request in specific circumstances.

serviceDomains.name: Prospect Campaign Execution
serviceDomains.description: Execute a prospect campaign (version) and track and respond to impact

serviceDomains.name: Lead and Opportunity Management
serviceDomains.description: 'This service domain captures, classifies and track sales lead/opportunities with established clients for additional products or services. It handles the processing of the opportunity through to the point of formal offer processing.'

serviceDomains.name: Product Sales Support
serviceDomains.description: This Service Domain administers customer access to product specialists

serviceDomains.name: Customer Relationship Management
serviceDomains.description: 'This service domain develops and executes a customer plan to maintain and build a customer relationship. Activities include ongoing customer contact, tracking internal and external events and activity of interest and relevance, product and service matching and sales, processing ad-hoc queries, trouble shooting and issue resolution including the initial phases of troubled account recovery'

serviceDomains.name: Customer Behavior Insights
serviceDomains.description: This service domain applies behavioral analysis to customer event history to maintain a range of customer ratings/scores (such as 'propensity to buy') and to detect life events or trends

serviceDomains.name: Customer Credit Rating
serviceDomains.description: This service domain maintains and administers the bank's credit assessment for customers based on consolidated internal data and optionally by referencing external credit agency reports

serviceDomains.name: Customer Agreement
serviceDomains.description: This service domain maintains the master customer agreement/legal contract. Note that a customer can be a complex corporate entity with many subsidiaries operating in different geopolitical areas. The customer agreement is linked to as many Sales Product Agreements as needed for all in-force products

serviceDomains.name: Sales Product Agreement
serviceDomains.description: This service domain maintains a structured legal agreement defining the contractual terms and conditions for an in-force product for a customer. It is subordinate to the customer's master agreement that is maintained by the Customer Agreement service domain

serviceDomains.name: Customer Product And Service Eligibility
serviceDomains.description: This Service Domain maintains a list of products and services for which a customer is eligible.

serviceDomains.name: Customer Proposition
serviceDomains.description: This Service Domain maintains bank and customer defined requirements spanning all products and services

serviceDomains.name: Customer Event History
serviceDomains.description: 'This service domain captures, classifies and stores relationship, servicing and product fulfillment related customer events. In addition to servicing and product transaction details, the log can capture life/relationship events that are revealed during customer exchanges'

serviceDomains.name: Customer Product and Service Directory
serviceDomains.description: This Service Domain maintains the most important details of all the products and services that a customer has acquired from the bank.

serviceDomains.name: Loan Syndication
serviceDomains.description: "Loan Syndication is a Service Domain that supports orgination, set-up and servicing of syndicated loans. It provides services that are used in lead banks, agents and banks providing administrative support.\nIt handles the orchestration of origination and servicing processes for syndicated loans."

serviceDomains.name: Customer Financial Insights
serviceDomains.description: This service domain applies behavioral analysis to the customer financial history to develop financial insights that can highlight business development opportunities or detect possible concerns with a customer's financial wellfare

serviceDomains.name: Servicing Mandate
serviceDomains.description: This service domain maintains the allowed customer servicing arrangements for a service provider covering general access to the bank's products and services and optionally customer specific arrangements

serviceDomains.name: Servicing Order
serviceDomains.description: This service domain handles the processing of a customer servicing request as a predefined procedure. A range of standard servicing requests can be supported. The process can include a check of permissions when the request is made by a third party/service provider

serviceDomains.name: Customer Case Management
serviceDomains.description: Track and assess case load and resolution activity - allocate resources as necessary to optimize case resolution performance

serviceDomains.name: Card Case
serviceDomains.description: 'This service domain handles the processing of a customer card case, typically a disputed charge'

serviceDomains.name: Customer Case
serviceDomains.description: 'This service domain handles the initiation, tracking, resolution and reporting on customer cases (issues that typically require corrective response to some financial transaction)'

serviceDomains.name: Legal Entity Directory
serviceDomains.description: This service domain maintains details of the legal entity structure of the party including dependents and associations for individuals and ownership/subsidiary structures for corporations. Some financial indicators and product coverage/activity details can be included where this defines the nature of the legal entity relationship in particular for corporate entities

serviceDomains.name: Location Data Management
serviceDomains.description: This service domain maintain details of the use and state of locations of interest to the bank. This can include both physical and virtual addresses. It is used to check for valid use and for sales/marketing activities

serviceDomains.name: Party Reference Data Directory
serviceDomains.description: 'This service domain maintains a range of party reference information covering aspects including general reference details, contacts and associations and demographic information'

serviceDomains.name: Consumer Investments
serviceDomains.description: Handle the consumer front-end trading requests. These will typically be blocked/netted for market execution

serviceDomains.name: Investment Portfolio Management
serviceDomains.description: 'Manage an investment portfolio, initiating trading to leverage market opportunities, remaining within portfolio trading policies'

serviceDomains.name: Investment Portfolio Analysis
serviceDomains.description: 'Assess and report on investment portfolio make-up, valuation and performance'

serviceDomains.name: Investment Portfolio Planning
serviceDomains.description: Agree the policies and required make-up of an investment portfolio and ensure all required bank and regulatory terms and conditions are addressed

serviceDomains.name: eTrading Workbench
serviceDomains.description: This Service Domain supports consumer securities trading of their investment portfolio through the bank

serviceDomains.name: Public Reference Data Management
serviceDomains.description: 'Provide structured access to standard ''global'' reference data and definitions associated with market activity such as currency, country and segment identifiers.'

serviceDomains.name: Financial Instrument Reference Data Management
serviceDomains.description: This Service Domain maintains a directory of financial instrument reference data

serviceDomains.name: Financial Market Research
serviceDomains.description: The service domain consolidates external financial market research

serviceDomains.name: Financial Market Analysis
serviceDomains.description: Provide different types of financial market analysis using available financial market information and research

serviceDomains.name: Market Information Management
serviceDomains.description: Market information management consolidates and improves market information from multiple sources in order to build up a bank knowledge base in targeted areas

serviceDomains.name: Market Data Switch Operation
serviceDomains.description: This service domain operates the internal information distribution facility/switch in compliance with administered external subscription information feed service access rights. Note the content is retrieved by the Market Feed Operation service domain from the various external feed services. Internal information can also be published over the switch from various bank sources (such as bank rates provided by treasury).

serviceDomains.name: Customer Workbench
serviceDomains.description: This service domain represents customer side devices. Most commonly providing a customer access portal to the banks products and services through any suitable channel and device

serviceDomains.name: Contact Handler
serviceDomains.description: This service domain handles a customer's interactive contact with the bank. This will typically involve launching of one or more channel/device specific dialogue sessions as necessary within the customer contact

serviceDomains.name: Contact Routing
serviceDomains.description: 'The Contact Routing service domain tracks servicing resource availability and uses any known details about the customer contact (e.g. identity, indicated purpose of call, status of the relationship) to make an optimal routing decision. The routing selection may include matching the required product knowledge/skills to the available servicing resources.'

serviceDomains.name: Session Dialogue
serviceDomains.description: 'This service domain handles/structures the customer narrative during an interactive session. It consolidates and presents pertinent customer information and provides servicing guidelines with standard dialogue/scripting as appropriate. It can include the capability to provoke questions to capture key relationship and sales triggers. It also ensures the correct sequencing, dialogue content and actions are performed/initiated during the customer interaction. It may further leverage the session by passing on customer notifications, status updates and triggering sales/marketing efforts.'

serviceDomains.name: Party Routing Profile
serviceDomains.description: 'This service domain maintains a small profile of key indicators for a customer that is referenced during customer interactions to facilitate routing, servicing and product/service fulfillment decisions. This can include status (such as account in arrears), ratings (such as high value customer) and alerts (such possible fraud activity detected)'

serviceDomains.name: Transaction Authorization
serviceDomains.description: 'This service domain handles risk based authorization for interactive customer transactions. This combines the context (channel) transaction, customer details and recent activity analysis as appropriate. The authorization may require a specific level of party/customer authentication to get approval.'

serviceDomains.name: Customer Access Entitlement
serviceDomains.description: This service domain maintains the details of the allowed channel/device based access to products and services that the customer has in place.  This profile is referenced in servicing and fulfillment activity and may include customer preferences and access limits/constraints that span multiple products.

serviceDomains.name: Channel Activity History
serviceDomains.description: This service domains consolidates and captures customer channel usage activity to support channel activity analysis and also can be referenced for customer access authorization and routing decisions

serviceDomains.name: Processing Order
serviceDomains.description: 'The Processing Order Service Domain handles the processing of a service request that comes in via a secure channel from a known requestor, which is typically an automated process itself and not a customer.'

serviceDomains.name: Party Authentication
serviceDomains.description: This service domain provides a customer identify authentication service covering all channels and devices to support access to the banks products and services

serviceDomains.name: ATM Network Operations
serviceDomains.description: 'Handling the automated operation of the ATM network and linked devices, including tracing physical cash and document movements'

serviceDomains.name: Branch Location Operations
serviceDomains.description: 'The day to day administration of branch activity, including teller assignment and cash handling oversight'

serviceDomains.name: Advanced Voice Services Operations
serviceDomains.description: 'This service domain operates the telephone channel infrastructure, including the IVR and any other automated devices as appropriate. This includes handling default routing rules and intra-day/session adjustments to deal with peak load or other operational variations'

serviceDomains.name: eBranch Operations
serviceDomains.description: This service domain operates the bank's on-line web based electronic branch capabilities - controlling access and load balancing across available communications and processing resources to optimize performance/availability

serviceDomains.name: Financial Gateway
serviceDomains.description: 'This service domain operates automated message interfaces to secure networks such as SWIFT, TELEX, ACH and Financial Market/Exchange reporting services'

serviceDomains.name: Card Terminal Administration
serviceDomains.description: 'This service domain administers the POS Network including the inventory, terminal characteristics, deployment and status of the POS devices.'

serviceDomains.name: Card Terminal Operation
serviceDomains.description: 'This service domain handle POS operations including processing, capture and tracking of the transactions originating at the Point of Sale devices.'

serviceDomains.name: Product Inventory Distribution
serviceDomains.description: Administer the provisioning and distribution of product inventory across the branch network and/or distribute direct to customers (e.g. mail) where appropriate

serviceDomains.name: Branch Currency Distribution
serviceDomains.description: Schedule and coordinate the secure distribution of cash inventory across the branch and ATM networks.

serviceDomains.name: Correspondence
serviceDomains.description: This service domain orchestrates the production of pre-formatted correspondence and batches of correspondence (e.g. mail shots).

serviceDomains.name: Contact Center Operations
serviceDomains.description: Administer the day to day activity in the contact center - allocate positions and track staff availability and performance

serviceDomains.name: Point of Service
serviceDomains.description: 'This service domain operates servicing positions within the bank. It administers all media connections, inventory holdings (e.g. cash), provides access to support utilities and tracks servicing activity -e.g. time spent, activity logs, capturing servicing events including commission and training related actions. In cases servicing positions can be automated'

serviceDomains.name: Interactive Help
serviceDomains.description: Operate the automated facility that provides interactive context sensitive servicing guidance to employees and self-serve customers

serviceDomains.name: Servicing Issue
serviceDomains.description: This Service Domain handles production customer servicing issues detected in the customer servicing environment

serviceDomains.name: Servicing Event History
serviceDomains.description: 'This service domain captures, classifies and stores servicing activity and events to support root cause analysis'

serviceDomains.name: Service Directory
serviceDomains.description: 'This Service Domain presents a structured set of services that the customer can select from '

serviceDomains.name: Business Development
serviceDomains.description: 'Define, implement, track and assess the new business development plans'

serviceDomains.name: Market Research
serviceDomains.description: 'This service domain handles the capture of market research from multiple external sources. This can include live feeds, analysis and reports in any form. The information is classified/catalogued and stored for retrieval.'

serviceDomains.name: Market Analysis
serviceDomains.description: This service domain analyzes internal and external market information sources as necessary to develop specific market insights. It may maintain a collection of predefined market analyses and may also offer specific ad-hoc analysis on request

serviceDomains.name: Competitor Analysis
serviceDomains.description: 'Solicit, consolidate and analyze competitor specific public domain data to develop competitor insights and comparisons'

serviceDomains.name: Customer Campaign Management
serviceDomains.description: Assess the coverage and impact of internal/customer campaigns and redirect campaign development and execution activity accordingly

serviceDomains.name: Customer Campaign Design
serviceDomains.description: Design and refine customer campaign specifications based on their impact

serviceDomains.name: Customer Portfolio
serviceDomains.description: Maintain a portfolio of analytical views of the customer base to support customer segment profitability and performance analysis

serviceDomains.name: Advertising
serviceDomains.description: 'Develop the plan for and oversee advertising campaign activity, including budget and resource management'

serviceDomains.name: Promotional Events
serviceDomains.description: 'Develop the plan for and oversee promotional event activity, including budget and resource management'

serviceDomains.name: Brand Management
serviceDomains.description: Respond to events that potentially damage the brand or provide an opportunity to strengthen/leverage brand awareness

serviceDomains.name: Segment Direction
serviceDomains.description: Define market segments and develop and assess performance against the segment plan's performance goals

serviceDomains.name: Prospect Campaign Design
serviceDomains.description: Design and refine prospect campaign specifications based on their impact

serviceDomains.name: Customer Surveys
serviceDomains.description: Define and execute and analyze customer surveys

serviceDomains.name: Prospect Campaign Management
serviceDomains.description: Assess the coverage and impact of external/prospect campaigns and redirect campaign development and execution activity accordingly

serviceDomains.name: Product Portfolio
serviceDomains.description: Maintain a portfolio of analytical views of the product portfolio to support product profitability and performance analysis

serviceDomains.name: Product Design
serviceDomains.description: Develop/refine product designs and supporting specification details

serviceDomains.name: Production Release
serviceDomains.description: Maintain and apply production release tests for new and updated systems

serviceDomains.name: Product Deployment
serviceDomains.description: Plan and administer the production deployment new and updated products and services

serviceDomains.name: Product Quality Assurance
serviceDomains.description: Maintain and execute a portfolio of product quality assurance tests and certifications that can be applied to evaluate any aspect of production activity for quality assurance

serviceDomains.name: Product Training
serviceDomains.description: 'Develop and provide product specific training across the workforce. This includes all media and training mechanisms (on-line, self taught, classroom etc.)'

serviceDomains.name: Case Root Cause Analysis
serviceDomains.description: Root cause analysis business function reviews case reports to identify possible improvements to eliminate/mitigate servicing issues

serviceDomains.name: Product Directory
serviceDomains.description: 'This service domain maintains a comprehensive directory of the bank''s products and services. It can be referenced to obtain product details used to support activities including product selection, sales and marketing, on-boarding, servicing and product fulfillment.'

serviceDomains.name: IT Standards And Guidelines
serviceDomains.description: 'Define and apply comprehensive IT architectures, policies and standards as appropriate. Also define the IT usage guidelines and procedures governing systems use across the enterprise'

serviceDomains.name: Systems Administration
serviceDomains.description: 'Administer the configuration, maintenance, assignment and track usage and status of all IT assets deployed in development and production across the enterprise'

serviceDomains.name: System Development
serviceDomains.description: 'Develop new, enhance existing applications and integrate package based systems solutions'

serviceDomains.name: Contact Center Management
serviceDomains.description: Oversee the assignment and operation of the customer contact center

serviceDomains.name: Servicing Activity Analysis
serviceDomains.description: This service domain analyzes servicing activity to support continual service improvement

serviceDomains.name: Channel Activity Analysis
serviceDomains.description: 'This service domain tracks and analyzes channel activity to support relationship development, to detect unwanted behavior, possible fraud, and to constrain channel use as necessary (for example tracking usage frequency and cumulative transaction amounts within a period)'

serviceDomains.name: Branch Location Management
serviceDomains.description: 'Manage and oversee branch activity, assign resources to optimize branch performance'

serviceDomains.name: Advanced Voice Services Management
serviceDomains.description: Oversee the configuration and operation of the voice channel facilities

serviceDomains.name: eBranch Management
serviceDomains.description: Oversee the configuration and operation of the e-branch channel facilities

serviceDomains.name: Product Inventory Item Management
serviceDomains.description: Maintain and distribute product inventory

serviceDomains.name: Central Cash Handling
serviceDomains.description: 'Track cash inventory, project demand and allocate inventory across the branch/ATM network'

serviceDomains.name: Branch Currency Management
serviceDomains.description: 'Track cash inventory, project demand and ensure all cash is accounted for within the branch'

serviceDomains.name: Intellectual Property Portfolio
serviceDomains.description: Administer the bank's intellectual property assets

serviceDomains.name: Management Manual
serviceDomains.description: 'Develop, maintain and promulgate the management manual of required procedures and guidelines. Provide support in its reference and interpretation as appropriate'

serviceDomains.name: Enterprise Architecture
serviceDomains.description: Define and maintain comprehensive business architectural definitions/blueprints to help organize/direct the business

serviceDomains.name: Knowledge Exchange
serviceDomains.description: 'Consolidate, classify and provide structured access to consolidated market intelligence, product and procedural knowledge gained from the workforce in the execution of business to inform business activity and support continual improvement'

serviceDomains.name: Customer Behavior Models
serviceDomains.description: 'This service domain handles the design and maintenance of a portfolio of customer behavior models that might be used in all aspects of customer relationship development, sales, servicing and product fulfillment'

serviceDomains.name: Credit Risk Models
serviceDomains.description: This service domain handles the design and maintenance of a portfolio of credit models that are used in all aspects of customer credit assessments

serviceDomains.name: Fraud Model
serviceDomains.description: 'This service domain handles the design and maintenance of a portfolio of fraud models used across all production activity to detect potential fraud on the part of customers, merchants and other involved parties'
